about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established company within Malta's wine and beverage industry, for an enthusiastic and results-driven Business Development Manager – HoReCa to join its sales team in Paola.

You will develop new business across the HoReCa sector — hotels, restaurants and catering establishments — while managing existing client relationships and driving sales growth. The role covers client visits, negotiating commercial agreements, sales strategy, promotional activities, wine tastings and product presentations, point-of-sale displays and representing the company at industry events.

It suits a motivated sales professional with at least three years of sales, business development or field marketing experience, strong negotiation skills and commercial awareness. The full-time, Monday-to-Friday position pays €30,000–€35,000 per year plus performance-related bonuses, a company car, fuel allowance, company mobile and health insurance.

Collaborate with the sales team to identify market opportunities and strengthen brand presence
